verdicts.reason: A follows a sensible story order (badge, product, brand, headline, body, pills, CTA) with a prominent CTA. Its flaws: the centred GROVE wordmark sits over a left-aligned headline; the pills and CTA are pushed right while the body copy is flush left, so the column is ragged; the pills jam against each other; and the bottom is cramped compared with the generous top. B demotes the CTA to a tiny pill the same size as the badges, and the FREE DELIVERY sticker is lumped into that one row. Its body copy is stranded at the very bottom, under the CTA, which breaks reading order and hierarchy, and there is a big dead gap between the pills and the body.
